# Therapies For Kids

> NDIS-registered multi-discipline pediatric therapy provider in Sydney offering physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech pathology, and exercise physiology for children with developmental delays and disabilities.

Therapies For Kids is a comprehensive Sydney-based therapy center specializing in early intervention and intensive therapy programs for children aged 0-9 years. The clinic offers both in-clinic and telehealth services across Australia, with specialized programs including aquatic therapy, group therapy, and evidence-based interventions like DMIT/CME therapy.

## Key Topics

- NDIS (National Disability Insurance Scheme)
- Physiotherapy
- Occupational Therapy
- Speech Pathology
- Early Intervention
- Developmental Delays
- Cerebral Palsy
- Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
- Sensory Processing Disorder
- Motor Skills Development
- Intensive Therapy Programs
- Telehealth Services
- Group Therapy Programs
- Exercise Physiology
- Aquatic Therapy

## Core Therapy Services

- [Services Overview](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/services): Overview of physiotherapy, OT, speech pathology & exercise physiology services
- [Physiotherapy](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/physiotherapy): Children's physiotherapy for motor skills, sports injuries & rehabilitation
- [Occupational Therapy](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/occupational-therapy): OT services for sensory processing, fine motor & self-care skill development
- [Speech Pathology](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/speech-pathology): Speech pathology for language development & communication confidence
- [Exercise Physiology](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/exercise-physiology): Exercise physiology programs for chronic conditions & motor skill training

## Specialized Therapy Programs

- [Intensive Pediatric Therapy](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/intensive-paediatric-therapy): Personalised intensive therapy programs for developmental delays & disabilities
- [Early Childhood Intervention](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/early-childhood-intervention): Early intervention services for developmental delays in children 0-9 years
- [DMIT/CME Therapy](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/dmit-cme-therapy): Dynamic Movement Intervention & Cuevas Medek Exercise for motor delays
- [Aquatic Therapy](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/aquatic-therapy): Water-based therapy for strength, muscle relaxation & physical disabilities
- [Group Therapy Programs](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/group-therapy-programs): Term & holiday group therapy programs for social skills & real-world practice
- [Key Worker Model Programs](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/key-worker-model-aide): Key worker support model for NDIS-funded early intervention coordination

## Delivery Models

- [Telehealth & Online Therapy](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/telehealth-out-of-clinic): Online therapy delivery across Australia for speech, OT & physio services

## Conditions & Specializations

- [Conditions Directory](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/conditions): Directory of childhood conditions treated: cerebral palsy, autism, epilepsy
- [Cerebral Palsy & Movement Disorders](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/cerebral-palsy-movement-disorders): Cerebral palsy physiotherapy & treatment for spasticity & movement disorders
- [Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/asd-autism-spectrum-disorder): Autism spectrum disorder OT for sensory processing & skill development
- [Genetic & Metabolic Syndromes](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/genetic-conditions): Therapy for genetic & metabolic syndromes including Prader Willi & Angelman's
- [Epilepsy Syndromes](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/epilepsy-syndromes): Therapy programs for childhood epilepsy & seizure management support
- [Auditory & Vision Impairment](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/auditory-and-vision-impairment): Treatment for auditory & vision impairment including cortical vision impairment
- [Plagiocephaly & Torticollis](https://therapiesforkids.com.au/plagiocephaly-and-torticollis): Infant head shape & torticollis treatment with positional therapy guidance
